Beam: synthetic structured-light replay

Camera rays intersect planes, a sphere, a step and an opaque box. The virtual projector creates 10-bit Gray stripes. The unchanged historical numerical methods and an explicitly corrected adaptation reconstruct the resulting byte captures.

This is new simulated validation, before historical coordinate clipping and OpenCV median filtering. It does not run the Galaxy Beam camera, prism or projector. Drag the cloud to rotate; use the wheel to zoom.

Projected captures and recovered depth

First three rows: black, white, then Gray bits from most to least significant. Last row: ground-truth depth, historical depth, corrected depth, corrected 3D error. Depth color runs blue (0.3 m) to red (1 m); error blue (0) to red (15 mm); dark pixels are rejected/unilluminated. Historical values outside the scale saturate.

Results

Machine-readable metrics and conditions. PLY point clouds use metres. All plots and fixture values can be regenerated with Python and a local JDK.
